content:
As of the most recent completed season (2023), Max Verstappen won the Formula 1 World Drivers' Championship. He drives for Red Bull Racing and secured his third consecutive title in 2023, following his previous championships in 2021 and 2022.

Additionally, Red Bull Racing won the 2023 Formula 1 Constructors' Championship.
